description: AAC LTP (MPEG-4 ADTS profile 3), mono: 24 frames that use long-term prediction but 13 and 14, the sync word of frame 9 overwritten, so that the decoder starts again with an empty history and withholds the blocks that predict from it or from output it withheld: frames 10 to 13, until the pause of two frames lets the history refill.

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg resyncs after damage in its own way.
skip.faad: faad2 stops at the damaged frame.
